name: Saskia Laroo
bio_short: Saskia Laroo plays trumpet, saxophone and bass and sings. With keyboardist Warren Byrd she performs as Duo Laroo/Byrd, playing jazz, funk, soul and improvised music in the USA and the Netherlands. The duo played two Halloween-weekend concerts at Holland Tunnel Revisited in 2026.

verification.evidence: Duo Laroo/Byrd's Halloween-weekend concerts at Holland Tunnel Revisited (Oct 30 and Nov 1, 2026) were announced in a post shared by Saskia Laroo and the gallery's Instagram, listing the line-up and instruments. Not yet confirmed by the gallery for this profile.
